import urllib.request, json
req=urllib.request.Request('https://api.openalex.org/works/doi:10.1038/nn1352', headers={'User-Agent':'neuron-channels (mailto:a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk)'})
d=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=30).read())
out={
  'open_access': d.get('open_access'),
  'best_oa_location': d.get('best_oa_location'),
  'primary_location': d.get('primary_location',{}).get('source',{}).get('display_name') if d.get('primary_location') else None,
  'locations': [{'url':(l.get('pdf_url') or l.get('landing_page_url')), 'is_oa':l.get('is_oa'), 'version':l.get('version'), 'host':(l.get('source') or {}).get('display_name')} for l in (d.get('locations') or [])],
  'authorships': [{'name':a['author']['display_name'],'institutions':[{'name':i.get('display_name'),'country':i.get('country_code')} for i in a.get('institutions',[])],'orcid':a['author'].get('orcid')} for a in d.get('authorships',[])],
  'cited_by_count': d.get('cited_by_count'),
  'concepts': [c['display_name'] for c in d.get('concepts',[])[:10]]
}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
